references.text: Moses was commanded to wash Aaron and his sons with water at the entrance of the tent of meeting as part of their consecration ceremony.
Aaron and his sons were to wash their hands and feet in the large bronze basin before performing service, so that they would not die.
The Lord commanded Moses to bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
The Levites were to be cleansed by being sprinkled with cleansing water as part of their consecration for service.
Believers are to come forward with a sincere heart and with their bodies washed in clean water, which points back to the Levitical cleansing.
God saved us through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit, which is the spiritual fulfillment of the priests' cleansing.
Jesus washed his disciples' feet and explained the necessity of being washed to have a share with him, reflecting the priestly cleansing.
